Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the newest world record holder, GEORGE, for being the oldest human to ever live!

The room erupts in applause as George smiles, his face etched with joy and gratitude.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and a faraway look creeps into his eyes.

GEORGE (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young...

He begins to speak to himself, his voice barely above a whisper.

GEORGE (V.O)
Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Find Yourself Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Reincarnation. That You'll Keep Reincarnating Until You Reach The Ultimate Goal: Eternal Life.

As George speaks, his eyes glaze over, and his voice becomes more agitated.

GEORGE (V.O)
But What If It's Not Just A Theory? What If It's A Reality? What If I'm Already Trapped In This Loop?

George's voice rises, and his words become a frantic whisper.

GEORGE (V.O)
I'VE BEEN LIVING FOR 127 YEARS, AND I'VE SEEN SO MUCH. I'VE SEEN WARS, DEPRESSIONS, AND DISASTERS. BUT WHAT IF IT'S ALL JUST A DREAM? WHAT IF I'M JUST A CHARACTER IN SOMEONE ELSE'S GAME?

George's eyes roll back in his head, and he begins to thrash about in bed.

GEORGE (V.O)
I DON'T WANT TO BE TRAPPED! I DON'T WANT TO KEEP REINCARNATING! I WANT TO BE FREE!

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes wild and desperate.

GEORGE (V.O)
I'M GOING TO FIND A WAY OUT OF THIS LOOP. I'M GOING TO BREAK FREE FROM THIS NEVER-ENDING CYCLE.

As the camera continues to zoom in, George's face begins to contort in a mixture of fear and despair.

GEORGE (V.O)
BUT WHAT IF I'M ALREADY TOO LATE? WHAT IF I'M JUST A PUPPET ON A STRING, A MARIONETTE DANCING TO THE TUNES OF SOMEONE ELSE'S DESIRE?

The camera lingers on George's face, his eyes frozen in a mixture of terror and desperation.

FADE TO BLACK.
